title: 先天免疫缺陷 IEI

blocks.en: 90Inborn Errors of Immunity Michael H. Albert, Arjan Lankester, Andrew Gennery, and Bénédicte Neven 90.1 Introduction Inborn errors of immunity (IEI) arise from genetic defects that lead to abnormalities in immune cell development or function with a wide spectrum in severity and clinical manifestations. These include infectious, autoimmune, autoinflammatory, hematological, and malignant presentations. Allo-HCT provides a life-saving and curative treatment modality in many but not all of these disorders by replacing the defective hematopoietic cell lineage(s) by those from healthy allogeneic donors. Other management options including enzyme replacement therapy, gene transfer into autologous hematopoietic stem cells, and targeted therapies (see below) may provide an alternative or bridging approach to HCT in specific IEI.
blocks.zh: 【第90章：先天免疫缺陷（IEI）】作者：Michael H. Albert、Arjan Lankester、Andrew Gennery、Bénédicte Neven。〔90.1 導論〕IEI 源於造成免疫細胞發育或功能異常的遺傳缺陷，疾病嚴重度及臨床表現範圍很廣，可表現為感染、自體免疫、自體發炎、血液異常或惡性疾病。對許多、但並非所有這類疾病，allo-HCT 可透過健康異體供者的細胞，取代有缺陷的造血細胞系，提供救命且具治癒性的治療。其他選擇包括酵素替代治療、將基因導入自體造血幹細胞，以及下述標靶治療；在特定 IEI 中，它們可作為 HCT 的替代或橋接治療。

blocks.en: 90.2 Diseases IEI may be broadly categorized into severe combined immunodeficiencies (SCID) and non- SCID. To further subdivide non-SCID, the phenotypic classification as suggested by the International Union of Immunological Societies (IUIS) Inborn Errors of Immunity Committee can be used, which encompasses >500 genetic causes of IEI (Table 90.1).
blocks.zh: 〔90.2 疾病〕IEI 可概分為嚴重複合型免疫缺陷（SCID）與非 SCID。非 SCID 可再依國際免疫學會聯盟（IUIS）先天免疫缺陷委員會提出的表型分類細分；此分類涵蓋超過 500 種 IEI 遺傳病因（表90.1）。

blocks.en: Updated guidelines for HCT of IEI together with detailed protocols have been published by the EBMT Inborn Errors Working Party (EBMT IEWP) in 2021 (Lankester et al. 2021) and can be accessed at https://www.ebmt.org/sites/default/ files/2021- 07/EBMT%20ESID%20IEWP%20 Guidelines%20for%20HCT%20for%20 inborn%20errors%20of%20immunity.pdf These guidelines include detailed recommendations for the use of six conditioning regimens with varying degrees of intensity depending on type of IEI, patient condition, and age.
blocks.zh: EBMT Inborn Errors Working Party（IEWP）於 2021 年發表更新的 IEI 移植指引及詳細方案（Lankester 等，2021），可於原文所列 EBMT 網址取得。指引依 IEI 類型、病人狀況及年齡，詳列六種不同強度前處理方案的使用建議。

blocks.en: 90.3 SCID The overall frequency of SCID was for a long time estimated to be 1 in 50,000–100,000 live births. However, in recent years, newborn screening programs making use of the T-cell receptor excision circles (TREC) technology have demonstrated that the frequency may actually be two- or more-fold higher with clear geographical and ethnic differences (Kwan et al. 2014; Rechavi et al. 2017; Speckmann et al. 2023).
blocks.zh: 〔90.3 SCID〕SCID 的整體發生率長期被估計為每 50,000–100,000 名活產嬰兒一例。然而，近年運用 T-cell receptor excision circles（TREC）技術的新生兒篩檢顯示，實際發生率可能高出兩倍或更多，而且存在明顯的地理與族群差異（Kwan 等，2014；Rechavi 等，2017；Speckmann 等，2023）。

blocks.en: The immunological phenotypes of SCID are shown in Table 90.2 representing monogenic inherited defects in T-, B-, and NK-cell differentiation leading to the absence or inactivity of corresponding mature cells.
blocks.zh: 表90.2列出 SCID 的免疫表型，代表 T、B、NK 細胞分化的單基因遺傳缺陷，導致相應成熟細胞缺失或無法正常作用。

blocks.en: In the absence of newborn screening programs or positive family history, most patients present within the first 3–6 months with severe, recurrent, or opportunistic, often life-threatening, infections, the most common being Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia . Other common symptoms include diarrhea, dermatitis, and failure to thrive. Survival in SCID patients depends on expeditious T-cell reconstitution, and in the absence of successful HCT, or autologous stem cell gene therapy, most children usually die during the first year of life. As many as 50% of SCID patients are engrafted with maternal T-cells but in most instances these cells do not initiate GvHD. Transfusion-associated GvHD, on the other hand, is frequently lethal in SCID, and any patient with a possible diagnosis of SCID must receive irradiated blood products.
blocks.zh: 若未實施新生兒篩檢，也沒有陽性家族史，多數患者在出生後 3–6 個月內，出現嚴重、反覆或伺機性感染，常危及生命，最常見者為 Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia。其他常見症狀包括腹瀉、皮膚炎與生長遲滯。SCID 的存活取決於能否迅速重建 T 細胞；若未成功接受 HCT 或自體幹細胞基因治療，多數兒童通常在一歲內死亡。多達 50% 患者有母體 T 細胞植入，但多數情況下不會因此引發 GVHD。相反地，輸血相關 GVHD 在 SCID 常具致命性；任何可能患有 SCID 的患者，都必須接受經照射的血品。

blocks.en: Bacille Calmette–Guérin (BCG) vaccination can give rise to disseminated BCG-osis, and rotavirus vaccine can cause persistent enteritis in SCID patients, and all live vaccines should be avoided if there is any suspicion, a positive NBS result, or a positive family history of severe T cell deficiency. With the ongoing introduction of NBS in Europe, the presentation of SCID patient is about to change to mostly healthy-appearing newborns without signs of active infection. However, not all peri- and early postnatal infections like, i.e., CMV will be avoidable in infants identified by NBS (Speckmann et al. 2023; Thakar et al. 2023).
blocks.zh: BCG 疫苗可能引發播散性 BCG 感染，rotavirus 疫苗則可能造成持續性腸炎。因此，只要懷疑嚴重 T 細胞缺陷、新生兒篩檢（NBS）陽性，或具有陽性家族史，就應避免所有活性疫苗。隨著歐洲持續導入 NBS，SCID 患者的初次就醫樣貌正轉變為外觀健康、沒有活動性感染的新生兒。但即使經 NBS 及早辨識，也無法避免所有周產期及出生後早期感染，例如 CMV（Speckmann 等，2023；Thakar 等，2023）。

blocks.en: 90.3.1 General Principles in Allo-HCT for SCID The Stem CEll Transplant for primary Immune Deficiencies in Europe (SCETIDE) registry has collected data on SCID transplants comprising 50 years of HCT experience, and a number of  important publications have documented the outcomes and important risk factors (Fischer et al. 1990; Antoine et al. 2003; Gennery et al. 2010; Lankester et al. 2022). Recently, studies from the North American group have reported similar findings (Pai et al. 2014; Heimall et al. 2017, Thakar et al. 2023). The major factors positively influencing outcome reported in these studies include: 1. Absence of infections at HCT 2. Age at transplant <3.5 months or diagnosis via NBS 3. Use of MFD and MUD 4. Use of myeloablative conditioning 5. Recovery of naive CD4 T lymphocytes >0.5 × 10³/μL at +1 year after HCT
blocks.zh: 〔90.3.1 SCID 異體 HCT 的一般原則〕歐洲原發性免疫缺陷幹細胞移植登錄庫 SCETIDE，累積了涵蓋 50 年 HCT 經驗的 SCID 移植資料。多篇重要研究描述其結果與風險因子（Fischer 等，1990；Antoine 等，2003；Gennery 等，2010；Lankester 等，2022），北美團隊近期亦有相近發現（Pai 等，2014；Heimall 等，2017；Thakar 等，2023）。與較佳結果相關的主要因素包括：① 移植時沒有感染；② 移植年齡小於 3.5 個月，或由 NBS 診斷；③ 使用相合親屬供者（MFD）或相合非親屬供者（MUD）；④ 使用骨髓消除性前處理；⑤ 移植後一年 naïve CD4 T 淋巴球恢復至 >0.5 × 10³/μL。

blocks.en: 90.3.2  Donor, Graft Source, and Conditioning in HCT for SCID Overall survival for MD (related or unrelated) HCT in SCID has improved to over 90% (Lankester et al. 2022; Thakar et al. 2023).
blocks.zh: 〔90.3.2 SCID 的供者、細胞來源與前處理〕SCID 接受相合親屬或非親屬供者 HCT 的整體存活率，已改善至超過 90%（Lankester 等，2022；Thakar 等，2023）。

blocks.en: Virtually all infants have a haploidentical parental donor, and this is an alternative option, as the donor is readily available. HLA disparity necessitates rigorous in vitro or in vivo TCD in order to reduce to risk of GvHD. Most centers now employ either TCR alpha/beta depletion (Balashov et al. 2015; Shah et al. 2018) or PT-CY (Neven et al. 2019). Although promising survival rates have been reported, longer follow-up in a larger cohort of patients is required to determine the position of these approaches. CD34+ selection of the graft also remains an option in selected cases. CB can be a suitable alternative stem cell source (Fernandes et al. 2012). Theoretical advantages for using CB stem cells include rapid availability, less risk of GvHD compared to adult URD, no medical risk to the donor, and a greater proliferative life span which might be particularly important in such young recipients. There are some specific disadvantages including sometimes slower engraftment, lack of viral-specific cytotoxic T-cells, and lack of availability of the donor for a boost HCT.
blocks.zh: 幾乎所有嬰兒都有可立即取得的半相合父母供者，可作為替代選擇。HLA 不相合使得嚴格的體外或體內 T-cell depletion（TCD）成為降低 GVHD 風險的必要措施。多數中心現採 TCRαβ 去除或 PT-CY（Balashov 等，2015；Shah 等，2018；Neven 等，2019）；雖有令人鼓舞的存活率，仍需更大群體及更長追蹤來確立其定位。選定病例也可使用 CD34+ selection。臍帶血（CB）亦是合適替代來源（Fernandes 等，2012）。其理論優點包括取得迅速、相較成人非親屬供者較低的 GVHD 風險、供者無醫療風險，以及較長的增殖壽命——對這麼年幼的受者可能特別重要。缺點則包括有時較慢的植入、缺少病毒特異性細胞毒性 T 細胞，以及無法再次向同一供者取得追加移植物。

blocks.en: Although HLA-genoidentical sibling donor BM may be infused into SCID recipients without any conditioning or GvHD prophylaxis, usually only T-cells of donor origin will engraft, and myeloid and often B-cells will remain of recipient origin. Patients with insufficient myeloid engraftment and/or poor or declining naïve T-cell compartments may experience severe complications that require a second, conditioned HCT (Riller et al. 2023). Therefore, and if tolerable for the patient, conditioning is recommended for all SCID patients in order to achieve optimal clinical and immunological outcomes (Lankester et al. 2022).
blocks.zh: 雖然 SCID 受者可在沒有前處理或 GVHD 預防下，接受 HLA 基因型相合同胞的骨髓，但通常只有供者 T 細胞植入，髓系及常見的 B 細胞仍來自受者。髓系植入不足、naïve T 細胞群不足或持續下降者，可能出現嚴重併發症，而需第二次、且有前處理的 HCT（Riller 等，2023）。因此，只要病人能耐受，建議所有 SCID 患者使用前處理，以取得最佳臨床與免疫學結果（Lankester 等，2022）。

blocks.en: Individualized approaches making use of therapeutic drug monitoring provide novel and less toxic options to improve HCT outcome in these vulnerable young infants, while antibody-based conditioning approaches that may limit systemic toxicity are currently being developed.
blocks.zh: 結合 therapeutic drug monitoring 的個別化策略，為這些脆弱的小嬰兒提供較新的低毒性選擇，以改善移植結果；可能限制全身毒性的抗體型前處理，也正在開發中。

blocks.en: 90.3.3 Omenn’s Syndrome Omenn’s syndrome (OS) is characterized by SCID typically associated with the triad of erythroderma, hepatosplenomegaly, and lymphadenopathy. There is a marked eosinophilia and a variable number of autologous, activated, and oligoclonal T lymphocytes, which infiltrate target organs and are generally poorly responsive to mitogens. Whereas outcomes in HCT for OS were traditionally inferior compared to classical SCID, results have improved in recent years (Gennery et al. 2010; Heimall et al. 2017; Thakar et al. 2023). The overall mortality in these studies was lower than previously reported and was due to early recognition of OS and rapid initiation of treatment with topical/systemic immune suppression with steroids, cyclosporin A, and T-cell directed serotherapy to control immune dysreactivity before proceeding to HCT.
blocks.zh: 〔90.3.3 Omenn syndrome〕Omenn syndrome 是 SCID 的一種表現，典型三徵為紅皮症、肝脾腫大與淋巴結腫大。患者常有明顯嗜酸性球增加，以及數量不一、已活化且寡克隆性的自體 T 淋巴球；這些細胞浸潤標的器官，對 mitogens 的反應通常不佳。過去其移植結果較典型 SCID 差，但近年已改善（Gennery 等，2010；Heimall 等，2017；Thakar 等，2023）。這些研究的整體死亡率較早期報告低，歸因於及早辨識，以及在 HCT 前迅速以局部／全身性 steroids、cyclosporin A 及 T 細胞導向 serotherapy 控制異常免疫反應。

blocks.en: 90.4 Non-SCID IEI The landscape of HCT in non-SCID IEI has dramatically changed over the last decade • New genetic causes of IEI are being described in accelerating frequency thanks to next- generation sequencing techniques (Bousfiha et al. 2022). Functional consequences of genetic variants in the same gene can be broad, from complete or partial loss to gain of function resulting in different clinical phenotypes.
blocks.zh: 〔90.4 非 SCID 型 IEI〕過去十年，非 SCID IEI 的移植情勢有重大改變。① 隨著 NGS 技術發展，新 IEI 遺傳病因的發現速度加快（Bousfiha 等，2022）。同一基因不同變異可導致完全或部分功能喪失，乃至功能獲得（GOF），而產生不同臨床表型。

blocks.en: Somatic variants may also occur, mimicking disease caused by germline variants.
blocks.zh: 體細胞變異也可能造成與生殖系變異疾病相似的表現。

blocks.en: • The concept of “pure” immunodeficiencies with predisposition to infections has been abandoned with many newly described autoimmune, auto-inflammatory conditions, or syndromal disorders with immunodeficiency.
blocks.zh: ② 「純粹是容易感染的免疫缺陷」這個概念已被揚棄，因為越來越多疾病表現為自體免疫、自體發炎，或合併免疫缺陷的症候群。

blocks.en: Many of these diseases can be cured by HCT, while in syndromal disorders only the hematopoietic portion of the disease can be corrected, which may nevertheless be indicated and result in not just increased survival but also quality of life in selected patients.
blocks.zh: 許多這類疾病可由 HCT 治癒；若為症候群性疾病，HCT 只能校正造血相關部分，但對選定病人仍可能有適應症，且不只改善存活，也改善生活品質。

blocks.en: • HCT outcomes have further improved with around 90% OS and low GVHD rates after MSD or MUD HCT in many non-SCID IEI, like, i.e., CGD and W AS (Chiesa et al. 2020; Albert et al. 2022b).
blocks.zh: ③ HCT 結果持續改善：許多非 SCID IEI，如 CGD 與 WAS，接受 MSD 或 MUD 移植後，整體存活率約 90%，GVHD 發生率也低（Chiesa 等，2020；Albert 等，2022b）。

blocks.en: • In general, donor availability has become less of a factor in the decision-making process to go for HCT. Current outcomes of MFD and MUD are highly similar, while results with mismatched/haplo-identical HCT are gradually approaching those obtained with MD especially when performed in experienced centers (Shah et al. 2018; Neven et al. 2019; Kurzay et al. 2019).
blocks.zh: ④ 供者可得性在是否接受移植的決策中，影響已較以往小。MFD 與 MUD 的當代結果非常相近；不相合／半相合移植的結果也逐漸接近相合供者，尤其在有經驗的中心（Shah 等，2018；Neven 等，2019；Kurzay 等，2019）。

blocks.en: • The importance of DFS and GRFS as compared to OS is increasingly appreciated and addressed in medium- to long-term outcome studies, also in comparison to non-HCT approaches (Speckmann et al. 2017; Barzaghi et al. 2018; Albert et al. 2022b).
blocks.zh: ⑤ 相較於只看 OS，中長期研究越來越重視 DFS 與 GRFS，並將其與非移植策略比較（Speckmann 等，2017；Barzaghi 等，2018；Albert 等，2022b）。

blocks.en: • More IEI patients are discovered with very mild or atypical phenotypes of well-known IEI, and these often hypomorphic genetic variants are especially challenging with respect to timely recognition and management (Notarangelo et al. 2016; Schuetz et al. 2023).
blocks.zh: ⑥ 越來越多已知 IEI 被發現具有極輕微或非典型表型；這些常為 hypomorphic variants 的病例，在及早診斷與處理上特別困難（Notarangelo 等，2016；Schuetz 等，2023）。

blocks.en: Especially in these “milder” cases, often recognized in adolescence and adulthood, quality of life is increasingly a factor in HCT decision making (Cole et al. 2013; Cheminant et al. 2023).
blocks.zh: 尤其是青春期或成年後才辨識出的「較輕症」病例，生活品質已成為移植決策中越來越重要的考量（Cole 等，2013；Cheminant 等，2023）。

blocks.en: • Adolescents and young adults with IEI are increasingly appreciated as candidates for HCT, and outcomes are encouragingly good (Albert et al. 2018; Fox et al. 2018), with survival determined by the underlying IEI entity, pre HCT comorbidities, and organ damage rather than age at HCT or donor type (Albert et al. 2022a).
blocks.zh: ⑦ 青少年及年輕成人 IEI 患者逐漸被視為 HCT 候選人，結果亦令人鼓舞（Albert 等，2018；Fox 等，2018）。存活主要取決於 IEI 類型、移植前共病與器官損傷，而非移植年齡或供者類型（Albert 等，2022a）。

blocks.en: The consequence of these developments has been that many more patients with IEI are today considered for, referred for, and counselled about HCT.
blocks.zh: 這些發展使更多 IEI 患者被考慮接受移植、被轉介，並接受 HCT 諮詢。

blocks.en: 90.4.1 Indication One of the most challenging aspects of transplant for non-SCID IEI is the question of whether a high-intensity, curative therapy with HCT is indicated. For some IEI (like FHLH), the immediate HCT indication is clear, while for many other IEI this will be less evident because of the high interindividual variability of the clinical phenotype. In diseases where long-term prognosis is known to be poor, even presymptomatic patients can be subjected to HCT (like i.e. X-CGD). A genetic diagnosis is increasingly made in IEI patients and may support the decision to proceed to HCT. Similarly, a positive family history with severe disease manifestations or a known poor long-term prognosis of the disease may justify early preemptive HCT. Still, given the highly variable and frequently unpredictable disease course in IEI, a genetic diagnosis alone without clinical manifestations is in many IEI an insufficient reason to perform HCT. In all IEI patients, the decision to proceed with HCT should always include interdisciplinary discussions with patients and their families, also addressing issues like fertility/family-planning, school/work, other psycosocial factors, and quality of life.
blocks.zh: 〔90.4.1 適應症〕非 SCID IEI 最困難的問題之一，是是否有必要接受高強度、具治癒性的 HCT。某些疾病如家族性 HLH，其立即移植適應症明確；其他疾病則因臨床表型個體差異很大而不易判斷。若已知長期預後差，例如 X-linked CGD，甚至可在症狀前移植。遺傳診斷越來越普遍，可支持移植決策；家族有嚴重表現，或疾病已知長期預後不佳，也可能合理化早期先發 HCT。但 IEI 病程高度多變且常難預測，許多疾病只有遺傳診斷而無症狀，仍不足以構成移植理由。所有 IEI 的移植決策，都應由跨專科團隊與患者、家屬討論，涵蓋生育／家庭計畫、學校／工作、心理社會因素與生活品質。

blocks.en: 90.4.2 Conditioning (Table 90.3) In IEI, it is the goal is to establish sufficient long-term donor chimerism in the affected cell lineage, while reducing short- and long-term toxicity to a minimum. The required degree of donor chimerism for effective and sustainable disease correction varies depending on the type of IEI and has not yet been established for all entities.
blocks.zh: 〔90.4.2 前處理；見表90.3〕IEI 移植的目標，是在受影響細胞系中建立足夠、長期的供者嵌合，同時將短長期毒性降至最低。要達成有效且持續的疾病校正，所需供者嵌合程度因 IEI 而異，並非所有疾病都已確立。

blocks.en: Accordingly, the graft source, serotherapy, and type of conditioning regimen should be chosen depending on many factors, including IEI entity, age of patient, donor type, active infections, comorbidities, organ damage, and experience of the center.
blocks.zh: 因此，細胞來源、serotherapy 與前處理方案，應綜合 IEI 類型、年齡、供者、活動性感染、共病、器官損傷及中心經驗選擇。

blocks.en: Conventional MAC preparation with BU-/ CY-based regimens has historically been associated with significant treatment-related toxicity and TRM. The IEWP of EBMT had begun in 2005 to publish detailed recommendations for conditioning of IEI as discussed above (Lankester et al. 2021). These recommendations include: 1. Replacement of CY with FLU, as the combination of BU/FLU with pharmacokinetic targeting of BU AUC appears to be better tolerated in these patients.
blocks.zh: 傳統 BU／CY 骨髓消除性前處理，有顯著治療相關毒性與死亡率。EBMT IEWP 自 2005 年起發表 IEI 前處理詳細建議（Lankester 等，2021），包括：① 用 FLU 取代 CY，因為 BU／FLU 加上以 BU AUC 為目標的藥動學調整，在此族群似乎耐受較佳。

blocks.en: 2. The option to replace BU with a structural analogue, TREO, which is similarly immunoand myelosuppressive but causes less hepatic SOS/VOD (Slatter et al. 2018).
blocks.zh: ② 可用 BU 的結構類似物 TREO 取代 BU；其免疫及骨髓抑制作用相近，但較少肝臟 SOS／VOD（Slatter 等，2018）。

blocks.en: 3. Addition of a submyeloablative dosing regimen for BU/FLU (Güngör et al. 2014).
blocks.zh: ③ 加入 BU／FLU 的 submyeloablative 劑量方案（Güngör 等，2014）。

blocks.en: 4. Establishing RIC to achieve stable engraftment of immunocompetent donor cells with reduced procedure-related morbidity and mortality (Veys 2010).
blocks.zh: ④ 建立 RIC，讓具免疫能力的供者細胞穩定植入，同時降低程序相關罹病與死亡（Veys，2010）。

blocks.en: 5. An alkylator-low regimen for radiosensitive disorders (Slack et al. 2018).
blocks.zh: ⑤ 對放射敏感疾病使用低 alkylator 劑量方案（Slack 等，2018）。

blocks.en: 90.5 HCT for Radiosensitive IEI Patients with radiosensitive IEI such as Nijmegenbreakage syndrome, DNA ligase 4 deficiency, Cernunnos deficiency, or DNA-PKcs deficiency including those with a SCID phenotype are increasingly being identified and considered for HCT. As many of the conditioning regimens are particularly damaging to DNA, less toxic regimens are required to successfully treat these patients (Slack et al. 2018). No definitive studies are available, but low-dose FLU/CY regimens like the one suggested by the EBMT IEWP guidelines have been proven effective and safe (Lankester et al. 2021).
blocks.zh: 〔90.5 放射敏感型 IEI 的 HCT〕Nijmegen breakage syndrome、DNA ligase 4、Cernunnos 或 DNA-PKcs 缺陷等放射敏感 IEI，包括具 SCID 表型者，越來越常被辨識並評估 HCT。許多前處理對 DNA 具有強烈損傷作用，因此需較低毒性的方案（Slack 等，2018）。雖然缺乏決定性比較研究，EBMT IEWP 指引建議的低劑量 FLU／CY 等方案，已顯示有效性與安全性（Lankester 等，2021）。

blocks.en: 90.6 Alternative Therapies Alternative treatments to HCT have been developed for specific IEI over the last three decades.
blocks.zh: 〔90.6 替代治療〕過去三十年，已針對特定 IEI 開發 HCT 以外的治療。

blocks.en: 90.6.1 Enzyme Replacement Therapy (ERT) for Adenosine Deaminase Deficiency (ADA-SCID) Enzyme replacement in ADA deficiency with PEG-ADA is administered weekly or twice weekly by IM injection and leads to rapid metabolic correction which is followed by cellular and humoral immune reconstitution. The extent of immune recovery is variable, and a significant number (~50%) remain on Ig replacement. Over a longer time period, patients show a decline in T-cell numbers and remain lymphopenic. Long-term follow-up shows that patients may remain clinically well, but clinical problems can arise and a number of cases of EBV-related lymphoma have been reported (Chan et al. 2005). Given the  improved outcomes of HCT and GT in recent times, ERT is predominantly considered as a bridge to stem cell-based curative therapy.
blocks.zh: 〔90.6.1 ADA-SCID 的酵素替代治療〕ADA 缺陷可用 PEG-ADA，每週一次或兩次肌肉注射，迅速校正代謝異常，接著出現細胞及體液免疫重建。免疫恢復程度不一，仍有約 50% 需要 Ig 替代。時間拉長後，T 細胞數會下降，淋巴球低下持續存在。長期追蹤顯示，病人可維持臨床良好，但仍可能出現問題，且已有數例 EBV 相關淋巴瘤報告（Chan 等，2005）。由於近年 HCT 與基因治療結果改善，ERT 主要被視為通往幹細胞治癒性療法的橋接。

blocks.en: 90.6.2 Gene Therapy for Specific IEI Autologous stem cell gene therapy (GT) via vector- mediated transfer of healthy copies of an affected gene into autologous CD34 + cells has progressed from a highly experimental therapy to the first licensed gene therapy for an IEI (ADA- SCID) within the last two decades. One of the major conceptual advantages of GT is the elimination of the inherent risk of GVHD associated with allogeneic HCT procedures.
blocks.zh: 〔90.6.2 特定 IEI 的基因治療〕以載體把正常基因副本導入自體 CD34+ 細胞的幹細胞基因治療，在過去二十年已從高度實驗性治療，發展為首個獲准用於 IEI（ADA-SCID）的基因療法。其重要概念優勢之一，是消除異體 HCT 固有的 GVHD 風險。

blocks.en: Clinical trials performed with gamma retroviral vectors for ADA-SCID, X-linked SCID (SCID-X1), chronic granulomatous disease (CGD), and Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome (W AS) demonstrated that gene therapy can be an effective treatment option in patients lacking an HLA-identical donor (Hacein-Bey-Abina et al. 2002; Boztug et al. 2010; Stein et al. 2010; Aiuti et al. 2009). However, a high rate of insertional mutagenesis was observed in trials for SCID-X1, W AS, and CGD (Ott et al. 2006; Hacein-Bey- Abina et al. 2003; Braun et al. 2014). This has prompted the development of safer vectors based on self-inactivating retroviral or lentiviral vectors. Currently, a number of trials are ongoing or concluded for a number of IEI. All share the concept of submyeloablative conditioning followed by the infusion of autologous stem/progenitor cells transduced with the wildtype gene.
blocks.zh: ADA-SCID、SCID-X1、CGD 與 WAS 的 γ-retroviral vector 試驗，證實對缺乏 HLA 相合供者者，基因治療可有效（Hacein-Bey-Abina 等，2002；Boztug 等，2010；Stein 等，2010；Aiuti 等，2009）。但 SCID-X1、WAS、CGD 試驗出現較高比例 insertional mutagenesis（Ott 等，2006；Hacein-Bey-Abina 等，2003；Braun 等，2014），促使研究者開發更安全的 self-inactivating retroviral 或 lentiviral vectors。目前多項 IEI 試驗進行中或已結束，共同概念是 submyeloablative 前處理後，回輸導入野生型基因的自體幹／祖細胞。

blocks.en: Promising results were published, especially for ADA-SCID (Kohn et al. 2021; Cicalese et al. 2016), W AS (Ferrua et al. 2019) and SCID-X1 (Mamcarz et al. 2019). It is expected that gene editing approaches as an alternative for gene addition technologies will be developed for stem cell based GT in the next few years and may potentially also be employed to correct mature cells in diseases like, i.e., CD40 ligand deficiency, CTLA4, and IPEX.
blocks.zh: ADA-SCID（Kohn 等，2021；Cicalese 等，2016）、WAS（Ferrua 等，2019）與 SCID-X1（Mamcarz 等，2019）已有令人鼓舞的結果。作者預期未來幾年，基因編輯將成為 gene addition 的替代技術，用於幹細胞基因治療，也可能校正 CD40 ligand deficiency、CTLA4 或 IPEX 等疾病的成熟細胞。

blocks.en: In theory, autologous stem cell gene therapy offers the appealing prospect of avoiding alloimmune reactions such as GVHD or rejection and a lower conditioning-related toxicity compared to allo-HCT. But its exact role in treatment algorithms still needs to be defined in the absence of comparative studies. Also, logistic, regulatory, and economic hurdles still have to be overcome before its widespread application in the treatment of IEI. Nevertheless, it has widened the therapeutic repertoire for patients with some IEI. The rapid evolution of novel gene correction approaches has the potential to lead to even safer and more effective treatment options.
blocks.zh: 理論上，自體幹細胞基因治療可避免 GVHD、排斥等異體免疫反應，前處理毒性也較 allo-HCT 低。但缺乏比較研究，使其在治療流程中的精確定位仍未定；廣泛應用前，也須克服物流、法規與經濟障礙。儘管如此，它已擴大某些 IEI 的治療選擇，快速發展的基因校正方法有望進一步提高安全性與有效性。

blocks.en: 90.6.3 Targeted Therapies The unravelling of new genetic IEI entities, especially those caused by gain-of-function (GOF) variants and their pathophysiology, has for the first time opened the possibility to treat these diseases with highly specific, often small molecule inhibitors, some of which are already approved for other indications. These include but are not limited to abatacept for CTLA4 haploinsufficiency, ruxolitinib and other JAK-inhibitors for STAT1 GOF, leniolisib for APDS, etanercept for ADA2 deficiency, and IL-1-targeted therapies (anakinra, rilonacept, and canakinumab) for auto-inflammatory recurrent fever syndromes (Ochs and Petroni 2018; Ombrello et al. 2019; Rao et al. 2023). We can expect that more substances (like, i.e., IL-18BP for XIAP) may be licensed or repurposed for the treatment of IEI in the future. At this point in time, the exact role of these agents in the treatment algorithm of IEI is unclear. Ideally, they could make HCT unnecessary for some patients. On the other hand, concerns about long-term toxicity, infection risk, and lymphoma risk exist. In any case, in some patients with excessive autoimmunity and/or inflammation, these therapies can be viewed as an ideal bridge to HCT and considered as a remission induction strategy to control the underlying IEI, because they have the potential to bring the patient into the best possible clinical condition for HCT.
blocks.zh: 〔90.6.3 標靶治療〕新 IEI 遺傳病因，尤其 GOF 變異與病生理的解析，使疾病首次可能以高度專一、常為小分子抑制劑的藥物治療，其中部分已獲准用於其他適應症。例子包括：CTLA4 haploinsufficiency 的 abatacept、STAT1 GOF 的 ruxolitinib 或其他 JAK inhibitors、APDS 的 leniolisib、ADA2 deficiency 的 etanercept，以及自體發炎反覆發燒症候群的 IL-1 標靶藥 anakinra、rilonacept、canakinumab（Ochs 與 Petroni，2018；Ombrello 等，2019；Rao 等，2023）。未來可能有更多藥物獲准或轉用，如 XIAP 的 IL-18BP。目前其精確治療定位未明；理想情況可讓部分患者免於 HCT，但長期毒性、感染與淋巴瘤風險仍令人關切。對過度自體免疫／發炎者，這些藥可作為理想移植橋接或緩解誘導，控制 IEI，使病人以最佳臨床狀況接受 HCT。

blocks.en: Key Points: IEI require a tailored approach to HCT management, and disease-specific transplant protocols have been developed for these diseases, including stem cell-based GT. Preceding comorbidity, particularly infectious complications at HCT and concurrent end-organ damage, adversely affects outcome. For many diseases, HCT at an early age is recommended. Alternative therapies—often as a bridge to transplant—are increasingly available to improve patient outcomes.
blocks.zh: 【章末重點】① IEI 需要個別化移植策略，已有疾病專屬方案，包括幹細胞基因治療。② 既有共病，尤其移植時感染及終末器官損傷，會惡化結果；許多疾病建議較年幼時移植。③ 替代療法越來越多，常作為移植橋接，以改善病人結果。
